info.name: List publications <Badge intent="info" minimal outlined>OAuth Scope: publications:read</Badge>

params.name: expand
params.description: Optionally expand the results by adding additional information like subscription counts and engagement stats.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. The limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

params.name: page
params.description:
Pagination returns the results in pages. Each page contains the number of results specified by the `limit` (default: 10).
If not specified, results 1-10 from page 1 will be returned.

params.name: direction
params.description:
The direction that the results are sorted in. Defaults to asc
`asc` - Ascending, sorts from smallest to largest.
`desc` - Descending, sorts from largest to smallest.

params.name: order_by
params.description:
The field that the results are sorted by. Defaults to created
`created` - The time in which the publication was first created.
`name` - The name of the publication.
